level9Scenes.caption: Stepping back from the canvas as the gallery curator nods in approval.
level9Scenes.explanation: Chin tilted slightly up (+10 deg), expanded posture, and a small symmetric smile (AU12) in an accomplishment setting signal pride and satisfaction.

level9Scenes.caption: Accidentally knocking over a water glass at a quiet dinner table.
level9Scenes.explanation: Downward gaze, slight head turn, sheepish controlled smile (AU12+24), and hand-to-face touch after a minor social slip indicate embarrassment.

level9Scenes.caption: Tracing an elusive timing bug across three log panels late in the afternoon.
level9Scenes.explanation: Furrowed brows (AU4) and narrowed lids (AU7) with a relaxed mouth while leaning toward a complex task reflect focused concentration, not anger.

level9Scenes.caption: Listening to a vendor promise a 300% speedup with zero engineering effort.
level9Scenes.explanation: A unilateral outer brow raise (AU2) combined with a pushed-up chin boss (AU17) and evaluating posture signals skepticism.

level9Scenes.caption: Watching a teammate land awkwardly on their ankle during a sprint.
level9Scenes.explanation: Lowered brows (AU4), raised cheeks (AU6), tightly squeezed lids (AU7), and nasal wrinkling (AU9) while witnessing an injury express empathetic pain.

level9Scenes.caption: Sitting alone outside the director's office after letting the team down on a key safety check.
level9Scenes.explanation: Deep head drop (-20 deg), collapsed shoulders, and sad lower-face tension without any sheepish smile point to shame.

level9Scenes.caption: Stepping out onto a high mountain ridge as the clouds part over a vast valley.
level9Scenes.explanation: Widened eyes and raised brows with a slightly parted jaw before a vast natural vista convey awe.

level9Scenes.caption: Leafing through an old photo album from childhood summers at a grandparents' house.
level9Scenes.explanation: A gentle warm smile (AU6+12) paired with wistful oblique inner brows (AU1) while looking at old memories captures nostalgia.

level9Scenes.caption: Listening to the fourth consecutive hour of unedited budget spreadsheet readings.
level9Scenes.explanation: Slack facial tone, heavy eyelids, and slumped posture in an unstimulating environment indicate boredom.

level9Scenes.caption: Hearing the surgeon step out and say the procedure went smoothly.
level9Scenes.explanation: Dropping shoulders, softening brow tension, and a quiet warm smile after anxious waiting signal relief.

level9Scenes.caption: Watching a rival receive the innovation prize for an idea similar to yours.
level9Scenes.explanation: Oblique inner brow pull (AU1) colliding with brow lowering (AU4) and tightened lips (AU15+23) in a competitive loss context signals envy and resentment.

level9Scenes.caption: Sitting beside a close friend who is recounting a difficult week.
level9Scenes.explanation: Forward lean, attentive gaze, and concerned oblique brows (AU1+4) while listening to a friend's hardship express sympathy.

level9Scenes.caption: Seeing an instrument readout display negative pressure when the valve is wide open.
level9Scenes.explanation: Knitted brows (AU4+7) paired with a lateral head tilt in front of contradictory data indicate confusion.

level9Scenes.caption: Opening the studio door to find the entire team holding cake and banners.
level9Scenes.explanation: Arched brows and wide eyes (AU1+2+5) combined with a full Duchenne smile (AU6+12) show delighted surprise.

level9Scenes.caption: Uncovering a container of spoiled seafood left unrefrigerated over the weekend.
level9Scenes.explanation: Wrinkled nasal bridge (AU9) and raised upper lip (AU10) while recoiling from spoilage clearly express disgust.

level10ContextSwaps.title: Knitted Brows (AU4 + AU7): Debugging vs. Interrupted

sceneA.caption: Maya is silently reading a dense architectural diagram on her monitor.

options: Is now a good time to jump in, or would you like 15 minutes to finish reading that section?
Why are you angry at me?
followUp.best: Is now a good time to jump in, or would you like 15 minutes to finish reading that section?

sceneB.caption: Maya has just been interrupted for the third time in two minutes while answering a question.

options: Sorry, we cut across you there — please finish your point, Maya.
I know what you are thinking.
Let's move on since you have nothing to add.
followUp.best: Sorry, we cut across you there — please finish your point, Maya.

level10ContextSwaps.title: Wince (AU4 + AU6 + AU7 + AU9): Bright Sunlight vs. Bad News

sceneA.caption: Stepping out of a dark cinema lobby directly into noon glare on white concrete.

options: Want to step under the awning where the sun isn't right in our eyes?
What did I say that disgusted you?
Why are you upset with me?
followUp.best: Want to step under the awning where the sun isn't right in our eyes?

sceneB.caption: Hearing a colleague describe a painful bicycle crash on the morning commute.

options: That sounds rough — are they okay, and do they need a hand getting home?
Why are you making that face at me?
You look angry about the bike lane.
followUp.best: That sounds rough — are they okay, and do they need a hand getting home?

level10ContextSwaps.title: Controlled Smile + Gaze Down: Compliment vs. Mistake

sceneA.caption: The whole room applauds Jordan for quietly mentoring three new engineers.

options: No need to give a big speech — we just wanted to thank you for helping everyone onboard.
Why aren't you happy about the award?
Why are you looking at the floor?
followUp.best: No need to give a big speech — we just wanted to thank you for helping everyone onboard.

sceneB.caption: Jordan realizes their microphone was unmuted while humming during a client call.

options: Happens to everyone on remote calls — let's dive right into slide two!
Why did you disrupt the client?
You look guilty of something bigger.
followUp.best: Happens to everyone on remote calls — let's dive right into slide two!

level10ContextSwaps.title: Oblique Brows + Soft Smile (AU1 + AU6 + AU12): Farewell vs. Sympathy

sceneA.caption: Packing the last box on the final day in a beloved studio space before moving to a larger building.

options: Lot of great memories in this room — what's your favorite project we built here?
Why are you sad when we're upgrading?
Do you hate the new building?
followUp.best: Lot of great memories in this room — what's your favorite project we built here?

sceneB.caption: A junior teammate admits they stayed up all night worrying about their first demo.

options: First demos are always nerve-wracking — want to run through it together once before we start?
Why are you smiling at their stress?
followUp.best: First demos are always nerve-wracking — want to run through it together once before we start?

level10ContextSwaps.title: Wide Eyes + Arched Brows (AU1+2+5+26): Plot Twist vs. Sudden Noise

sceneA.caption: Opening an envelope to discover the grant committee funded the entire three-year budget.

options: Did the committee come back with the full grant decision?
What went wrong with the application?
Are you angry at the committee?
followUp.best: Did the committee come back with the full grant decision?

sceneB.caption: A heavy wrench slips off a shelf and clangs loudly onto the metal floor behind the bench.

options: That was a loud drop — is everyone clear of the shelf?
Why did you throw that wrench?
What are you hiding at the workbench?
followUp.best: That was a loud drop — is everyone clear of the shelf?

level10ContextSwaps.title: Unilateral Brow + Chin Raise (AU2R + AU17): Auditing Claims vs. Puzzling Out

sceneA.caption: Reviewing a timeline estimate that cuts QA testing from three weeks down to one afternoon.

options: It looks like you might have reservations about the QA window — what risks do you see there?
Why are you rolling your eyes at my plan?
followUp.best: It looks like you might have reservations about the QA window — what risks do you see there?

sceneB.caption: Tasting a new soup recipe to figure out which spice is missing.

options: What do you think — does it need a little more acidity or salt?
Why do you hate my cooking?
Don't eat it if you're disgusted.
followUp.best: What do you think — does it need a little more acidity or salt?

level10ContextSwaps.title: Pinched Brows + Stretched Lips (Fear Recipe): Near-Miss vs. Stage Fright

sceneA.caption: A cyclist swerves inches past the curb while you wait to cross.

options: That was way too close — take a breath, are you alright?
Why did you jump like that?
Why are you angry at me?
followUp.best: That was way too close — take a breath, are you alright?

sceneB.caption: Waiting backstage 30 seconds before walking out to keynote in front of 800 people.

options: Big crowd out there — want a sip of water or a quick breath together before you go on?
Why don't you want to be here?
You look like you're hiding something.
followUp.best: Big crowd out there — want a sip of water or a quick breath together before you go on?

level10ContextSwaps.title: Nose Wrinkle + Upper Lip Raise (AU9+10): Bad Odor vs. Unfair Clause

sceneA.caption: Walking past a leaking chemical solvent container in the storage room.

options: Do you smell solvent fumes near that cabinet? Let's ventilate and check the seal.
Why are you sneering at me?
Are you hiding something in the closet?
followUp.best: Do you smell solvent fumes near that cabinet? Let's ventilate and check the seal.

sceneB.caption: Reading a contract clause that shifts all liability onto entry-level contractors.

options: That clause seems to have struck a nerve — what part of the terms feels unfair?
Why are you making faces during contract review?
Are you afraid of the legal team?
followUp.best: That clause seems to have struck a nerve — what part of the terms feels unfair?

level10ContextSwaps.title: Pressed Lips + Lowered Brows (Anger Recipe): Heavy Lift vs. Boundary Crossed

sceneA.caption: Trying to loosen a rusted steel bolt that has been seized for years.

options: That bolt looks completely seized — want me to grab the long breaker bar?
Why are you furious at the equipment?
What did I do to make you mad?
followUp.best: That bolt looks completely seized — want me to grab the long breaker bar?

sceneB.caption: Being told on Friday at 5 PM that the weekend trip must be canceled for a non-urgent report.

options: I know springing this on Friday evening is frustrating — can we scope this so it waits until Monday morning?
Why are you hiding your feelings?
followUp.best: I know springing this on Friday evening is frustrating — can we scope this so it waits until Monday morning?

level10ContextSwaps.title: Posed Social Smile (AU12 Only): Polite Greeting vs. Masking Discomfort

sceneA.caption: Nodding politely to an acquaintance while walking past in the corridor.

options: Morning! Hope your week is going well.
Why wasn't that a real Duchenne smile?
Why are you faking happiness at me?
followUp.best: Morning! Hope your week is going well.

sceneB.caption: Saying 'Everything is fine, really' when asked how they are handling an overloaded schedule.

options: I appreciate how much you're carrying — if we took one project off your plate this week, which one would help most?
Your eyes didn't crinkle so I know you're faking.
followUp.best: I appreciate how much you're carrying — if we took one project off your plate this week, which one would help most?
